l2_pilot.renderer: subpixel fisheye rays with triangle depth and metric textures
l2_pilot.controlled_comparison: identical H0/H1 images and anchor observations; H1 adds native edge measurements using H0 joint initialization
l2_pilot.native_branch: separate per-camera cold starts plus joint BA
l2_pilot.status: synthetic-domain pilot; full production gates and evidence-backed L3 not yet validated

arms.R0: five ArUco anchors from rig0818 layout
arms.H1: the same Hybrid Carrier image geometry with correlated edge-normal residuals

pairing: Every arm receives the same target pose, camera state, world occluders, episode-level common bias, timing draw and standard-normal measurement draw.
projection: OpenCV-style equidistant fisheye polynomial, with declared K and four distortion coefficients.
estimator_proxy: Numerical pose Jacobian, whitened corner residuals, correlated edge-normal effective sample size, full-rank 6x6 FIM inversion and TCP covariance propagation.
metrics: common-success paired delta p95 with episode-block bootstrap
p95 over poses of worst-axis TCP sigma

gates.G0: All validation checks pass and measured R0 layout plus frozen camera snapshot are loaded.
gates.G1: A declared, repeatable geometry or visibility mechanism is large enough to justify L2.
gates.G2: Requires validated L2 detector evidence and L3 input distributions; CI lower bound of delta p95 >= 0.8 mm, H1 p95 <= 3 mm, rotation p95 <= 0.5 degree, coverage > 99% without decline, and no tail inversion.

non_claims: MC-lite detector acceptance is a sensitivity model, not a measured detector ROC.
Synthetic cameras and trajectories cannot certify production millimetres.
A browser-rendered geometry pass does not replace native detector image-loop validation or independent ground truth.
